title: 第119章 凶兽伏诛腹地惊踪第118章 执事临门暗流丛生
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 残存两头黑鳞异兽目睹同伴毙命，凶戾之气彻底冲破理智束缚。
原本还懂得试探周旋的巨兽，此刻全然不顾周遭袭来的法器灵光。
粗壮兽蹄重重砸在古老石砖上，地面接连泛起蛛网般的裂痕。
腥臭狂风伴随着巨兽咆哮席卷四方，前排几名炼气六层的弟子躲闪不及。
当场被异兽挥出的利爪扫中护身灵力罩。
单薄灵力屏障应声碎裂，几人倒飞出去，重重摔落在地。
胳膊、胸腹遍布深浅不一的血痕，一时之间再也无力起身参战。
坐镇后方的筑基执事眉头微蹙，指尖灵力悄然凝结。
一道淡青色灵力匹练悬在半空，随时准备出手驰援。
他身负管控秘境秩序之责，不能放任手下弟子接连惨死。
可眼下两头异兽困兽犹斗，贸然出手容易打乱众人合围节奏，只能暂且观望，等待修士们消耗异兽体力。
战场侧翼，萧辰带着一众负伤弟子刻意避开战圈核心。
他麾下人手本就灵力亏虚、伤势缠身，若是深陷混战，极易被发狂的异兽波及殒命。
一双眸子却死死穿梭在刀光兽影之间，视线片刻不离身处战团正中的林宸。
时时刻刻寻找偷袭破绽。
只要林宸被异兽重伤、灵力不济，萧辰便会立刻授意身边心腹，借着混战混乱出手暗算。
林宸立身厮杀中心，手中下品长剑寒光起落。
每一次挥剑都精准刺向异兽鳞甲缝隙的薄弱之处。
遗迹四周飘荡的天地灵气浓稠如雾，源源不断顺着周身毛孔钻入体内。
经由功法淬炼化作精纯灵力，不断填补挥剑斗法的消耗。
寂灭道体自主流转，但凡被异兽腥风裹挟入体的微量毒素。
转瞬就被丹田灵力冲刷消解，丝毫无法滞留在经脉之中。
他心里始终记着此行两大目的，一是搜集妖兽内丹、周边灵药。
依托遗迹充沛灵气慢慢积攒底蕴，稳步朝着炼气八层靠拢；二是深入遗迹内部，搜寻能够淬炼神识的上古功法。
眼前斩杀异兽所得内丹，便是最直接的修炼资源。
他出手分寸拿捏得当，不抢首功，却也不会错过收割战果的机会。
周遭参战修士见两头异兽已然狂乱，纷纷收拢阵型。
由几名炼气八层、炼气九层的好手牵头，从四面八方封死异兽逃窜路线。
各式法器灵光交织成片，金铁碰撞之声此起彼伏。
细密的伤口不断在两头异兽身上蔓延，乌黑兽血顺着鳞甲缝隙汩汩流淌，浸透脚下干裂的上古地砖。
又缠斗近两刻钟，左侧那头异兽体力彻底透支，动作迟缓大半。
content_en:
The two remaining black-scaled beasts witnessed the death of their companions, and their ferocity completely broke through the restraints of reason.
The giant beast that originally knew how to test and deal with it, now completely ignored the aura of magical weapons coming from around it.
The thick animal hooves hit the ancient stone bricks hard, and spider web-like cracks appeared on the ground one after another.
The smelly wind swept across all directions accompanied by the roar of the giant beast, and the disciples at the sixth level of Qi Refining in the front row were unable to dodge.
On the spot, the sharp claws swung by the alien beast hit the protective spiritual shield.
The thin spiritual barrier shattered, and several people flew out and fell heavily to the ground.
His arms, chest and abdomen were covered with bloodstains of varying depths, and he was no longer able to get up and join the battle.
The Foundation Establishment Deacon sitting at the back frowned slightly, and the spiritual energy on his fingertips quietly condensed.
A light cyan spiritual power train hangs in the air, ready to rush to help at any time.
He is responsible for controlling the order of the secret realm and cannot allow his disciples to die tragically one after another.
But now the two alien beasts are trapped and still fighting, and a hasty attack will easily disrupt the rhythm of the encirclement. They can only wait and see for the time being, waiting for the monks to consume the alien beasts' physical strength.
On the flanks of the battlefield, Xiao Chen led a group of injured disciples to deliberately avoid the core of the battle circle.
The men under his command were already weak in spiritual power and suffering from injuries. If they were caught in a melee, they would be easily affected by the crazy beasts and die.
A pair of eyes shuttled between the swords, lights and beasts' shadows, his eyes never leaving Lin Chen, who was in the middle of the battle group.
Always look for loopholes in sneak attacks.
As long as Lin Chen is seriously injured by a strange beast and loses his spiritual power, Xiao Chen will immediately instruct his confidants to plot against him through the chaos of the melee.
Lin Chen stood in the center of the fight, the low-grade long sword in his hand rising and falling with cold light.
Each swing of the sword accurately targeted the weak spot in the gap between the scales of the alien beast.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth floating around the ruins is as thick as mist, and it continuously penetrates into the body along the pores of the whole body.
After being tempered by the skills, it is transformed into pure spiritual power, which can continuously replenish the consumption of sword fighting.
The Nirvana Dao body circulates spontaneously, and any trace of toxins are carried into the body by the fishy wind of strange beasts.
In an instant, it was washed away and dissipated by the spiritual power of Dantian, unable to stay in the meridians at all.
He always kept in mind the two main purposes of this trip. One was to collect the inner elixirs of monsters and surrounding elixirs.
Relying on the abundant spiritual energy in the ruins, he slowly accumulated foundation and steadily moved towards the eighth level of Qi refining; the second was to go deep into the ruins and search for ancient techniques that could temper his spiritual consciousness.
The inner elixir obtained from killing the strange beasts in front of you is the most direct resource for cultivation.
He is well-measured in his shots and does not steal the first victory, but he also does not miss the opportunity to reap the results.
The surrounding monks participating in the battle saw that the two strange beasts were already in a frenzy and gathered their formations.
Led by several experts at the eighth and ninth levels of Qi Refining, they blocked the escape routes of the alien beasts from all directions.
The spiritual light of various magic weapons intertwined into pieces, and the sounds of gold and iron colliding one after another.
Fine wounds continued to spread on the two strange beasts, and black beast blood gurgled along the gaps in the scales, soaking into the cracked ancient floor tiles under their feet.
After another nearly two-quarters of an hour of fighting, the alien beast on the left was completely exhausted and its movements were mostly sluggish.
title_en: Chapter 119: A ferocious beast stalks the hinterland Chapter 118: Undercurrents abound when the deacon arrives
